items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Ivy was the only one I'd met in California except the members when they came to California.

ctx.x: You had known Ivy at the Apex in Los Angeles. Had you known anybody else who was in the band before you joined, or was Ivy the only person you had ever met before?

Ivy was the only one I'd met in California except the members when they came to California. They played California in '30 when they came out to make the Amos and Andy picture.

I didn't join till '32 which was the second time they came out.
